kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_akar_gao: The child with heavenly roots from the Slums was taken by Senior Gao to his sect's mountain. Her father paid his gambling debt with the advance and did not dare look at his wife.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_akar_pema: Xiao Yu, the sugar painter's child from the Slums, has formally become a disciple of %1$s's sect. Her mother drew a sugar dragon big as a hand and gave them away free all day.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_akar_ting: Xiao Yu refused to leave and is learning herb-craft from the town healer. She said, "Heaven can wait, my mother cannot." Some wept in the Slums, some laughed.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_dua_damai: The Zhangs and the Lis finally sat at one table! %1$s proved the well debt was settled long ago, and now the whole street is eating wedding cake.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_dua_lari: They say Zhang Shan and Li Ying eloped to the Water City, escorted by %1$s. Two fathers locked their doors and said nothing. The Three Aunts of the Well spoke for all of them.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_dua_pisah: Li Ying is to marry Master Shen's nephew. Zhang Shan does not leave his house, and the wine shop sees him more often than his mother does.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_feihu_per: The Crescent Moon Troupe left this morning. A bunch of flowers lay in the road, caught by no one. The flower girl keeps it in a vase at her window.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_feihu_tin: Yan Feihu did not leave with the troupe! He threw a flower from the top of the pyramid and this time it was caught, with both hands. Yan Feiyan thumped her brother's back until he coughed, then wept.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_hulu_bong: Wandering Healer Hu Lu was unmasked in the middle of the market by %1$s: his thousand-virtue pills were flour and chalk. He fled without his cart, and the cart was shared out.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_hulu_mitr: Hu Lu the wandering healer now has a fixed stall, and his pills are real: brewed from the herb garden he rents. People say it is strange to see a swindler work honestly, but profit is profit.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_jari_info: Purses in the Slums are suddenly safe. They say the Thousand-Finger Rat has a "special customer" now. Who says so? I never said so.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_jari_insa: A new locksmith shop opened in a Slums alley, its owner a former pickpocket, its capital from %1$s. Its first customers are the purses he once stole.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_jari_sera: Shi Xiaoqian's thousand fingers were finally marched to the Yamen. %1$s took his street children to the temple, and one of them is said to have been taken to the Recruitment Office.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_lagu_jemb: From under the bridge came a song I had never heard, played by Ah Qin with three phrases %1$s gathered from three towns. An old man stopped, bowed his head and said: "That is Shi Banqiao's song."
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_pejabat_s: Master Shen Wan's hoard was seized for the Granary on the order of %1$s, and the price of rice fell again before sunset. Some cheered, some noted who cheered.
Word is a new official likes red envelopes. Merchants smile wide, farmers smile narrow. Clerk Qiu notes everything and says nothing.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_pelindung: The banner of %1$s's sect was raised at the town gate, and the elder set off firecrackers late into the night. The bandits on the north road are said to be looking for other work.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_ronda_bar: The watch gong sounded again last night, this time from Xiao Bang's trembling but exact hands. %1$s sat beside him till the fifth watch.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_sup_bagi: Granny Tang cooked laba porridge by the hundred bowls, and %1$s fetched its ingredients from four shops and two towns. The temple was never so warm in the twelfth month.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_sup_cucu: Granny Tang's soup stall opened again this morning. Her granddaughter stirs, with the very same recipe. People queued without a word.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_tumbuh_re: The new street at the town's edge is named for %1$s! Madam Hong Ling's lion dance performed at its end, Foreman Gong Shu cut the ribbon, and three small children have already chalked the name on a wall.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_arak: The drunken poet at the wine house of %1$s composed a new verse, about the moon, he says. The shop closed early because the wine ran out, not because of the moon.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_bayi: A red egg hangs on a doorway at the end of the lane: a baby is born in %1$s. All the neighbours quietly count the months.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_catu: The two grandfathers playing chess under the locust tree have been arguing since morning about one elephant move made three years ago.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_cope: Careful near the East Market of %1$s: some say certain fingers have been working very fast lately.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_dong: The old storyteller at the teahouse just finished the Stone Monkey tale, and every small child in %1$s is now somersaulting off the steps.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_kuci: The old tabby at the fish market of %1$s refused raw fish today. The merchants confer: is it ill, or merely sulking?
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_laya: A dragon kite over the roofs of %1$s broke loose and fell into the Healer's yard. The children queued to apologise, and the Healer made them grind herbs as punishment.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_musi: The swallows are back in %1$s. The elders say that means new nests, new houses and new debts.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_nika: The Matchmaker is said to be busy. A good sign: two families in %1$s are sending each other cakes.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_pasa: Vegetable prices at the market of %1$s rose again. Some blame the rain, some the merchants, some the moon.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_rond: The night watchman of %1$s says his gong rang by itself last night. If not a ghost, he says, then surely a rat.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_sekt: A sect-robed person passed through the gate of %1$s yesterday and looked at the children longer than usual. Parents are starting to bar their doors more firmly.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_sumu: The Three Aunts at the well say the water of %1$s has grown sweeter since last season. Whether it is the water or the gossip, who knows.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_umum_tahu: Firecrackers are on sale everywhere in %1$s. The seller says he never raises prices, only adjusts them to the cheer.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_utang_lun: The Wu family's three-generation debt is paid! %1$s handed the silver to Master Shen Wan, who counted it twice and, they say, almost wept.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_utang_mod: The Wu noodle shop now has a new forty-percent partner: %1$s. The queue already reaches the bridge, and the debt is just a matter of seasons.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_utang_sid: Master Shen Wan was fined before Judge Bao for interest beyond the law. %1$s brought the document to the judge's desk. Small borrowers sent red eggs to the Wu house.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_wayang_pe: The premiere at the Shadow Theatre was full to the door. %1$s struck the gong, and Puppeteer Su wept after the screen went dark. A free ticket for life for the drummer.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota42_zhuazhou_: At their grandchild's zhuazhou feast, two grandfathers who had not spoken in twenty years sat side by side. %1$s brought them. The baby grabbed the brush, and both grandfathers wept.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_ayah.lunas: (He is silent a long time.) ...I will tell that sect man to take his silver back. And I will never touch dice again. I swear on... on those silly leaves.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_ayah.malu: Easy to say on a full stomach. But... ask her mother. She knows best what is good for the girl.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_ayah.mulai: What? You want to buy my child too? (He counts something on his fingers.) My dice debt is ten times my wages. That sect man offered enough to pay it twice. My girl would eat white rice on a mountain. Is that wrong?
(Pay his debt) If your debt is paid, you need not sell her.
Needs 10 coins times your band, and a talk with Gao first.
She is your daughter, not merchandise.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_gao.mulai: The Slum child? Heavenly roots, pure, unmixed. My sect offers rice, scriptures and the best masters. What do you offer, wanderer? Mud and dry leaves?
(Challenge) Let us settle it with swords. If I win, you withdraw.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_gao.putus: Family? Her father already decided, for a fair price. But please, go talk to those Slum rats.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_guru.kenap: Because yesterday a young man in a sect robe came to the Slums with a bag of silver. A child with heavenly roots appears not once in a hundred years, and those who buy children with silver seldom treat them as children.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_guru.mulai: The most diligent pupil in my class has never sat on a bench. She watches through the window, and whenever she whispers the answer to my question, the leaves in the yard whirl. A Slum child, the sugar painter's daughter.
Whirling leaves? I will meet her.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_guru.pesan: Her name is Xiao Yu. Bring her something sweet. A hungry child cannot think about the future.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_ibu.ingin: I want her to go where she can keep laughing. The Open Examination Day is close. Help us choose.
(Your sect) Bring her to your sect.
(Gao's sect) That Righteous sect is strong. Let her go with Gao.
(Stay) She is only nine. Let her grow up here.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_ibu.mulai: When Xiao Yu turned one, we laid out the zhuazhou mat. A brush, an abacus, scissors, a wooden sword. She reached for nothing. She laughed, and every one of them floated toward her. I knew from that day she would not be ours forever.
Then what do you want for her?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_ibu.pilih_: That mountain is far... but its rice is white. May they not clip her wings.
If you are her master, I can sleep soundly. Look after her. Let her come home every New Year.
Thank you. Master Zhou says she may sit on a bench from tomorrow. A real bench!
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_ibu_cara.b: (That night their voices carried to the alley. In the morning Yu Laosan returned the silver purse to Gao.)
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_ibu_cara.m: My husband has half sold our daughter. If you want to help, don't pay that man. Help me speak to him as a mother, not as a gambler.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_xiao_yu.mu: Want to see? (She laughs, and three dry leaves lift off the ground and circle her head like little birds.) The leaves like me! Father says not to show strangers. But you are not a stranger, are you?
No. Who else has seen this?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_akar_xiao_yu.si: A big brother in a white robe with a shiny sword. He gave Father a heavy purse. Since then Father won't look me in the eye. Mother cries in the kitchen.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_banjir_lapor.ku: Because it was laid by the book, and the book was written by people who had been flooded. Thank you. This town owes you one sleepless night.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_banjir_lapor.mu: The river withdrew. I saw it myself: right up to the end of my measuring cord, then it stopped. You did not sleep all night, did you? Your eyes look like a rabbit's.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_banjir_mulai.ba: Four jobs. Sand, timber, moving the stubborn, and one sleepless night on the embankment. Start with sand, it runs out fastest.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_banjir_mulai.ke: Because someone who lifts sandbags cares for this town far longer than someone who only pays. And because I see you walking these streets every day.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_banjir_mulai.mu: Hear that sound? That is the river, and it is hungry. All the mountain snow is coming down at once this year. If the lower quarter floods, the town loses a hundred houses and a generation of memory. I need hands.
Tell me what must be done.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_catatan_lapor.c: Hm. You write like someone who listens. Thank you. One day, if you wish to help run this town, come to my desk again.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_catatan_lapor.m: Done? Good, let me see. Five residents, an elder, a child. You did not copy from the notice wall, I hope.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_catatan_mulai.g: Taxes are reckoned from records, debts are proven by records, even street names are kept alive by records. A town without records has only memory, and memory is slippery as an eel.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_catatan_mulai.m: The town's old record book was eaten by termites. I need a new one, written by someone who walks the streets, not guessed at from behind a desk. Are you up to it?
What use is a record book?
Good. Five residents, one elder, one child. No need to talk about the weather. Ask what people are not usually asked: what they worry about, what they are thankful for.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_bibi_li.bay: That is what nobody ever tells. Strange, isn't it? Good gossip always loses its ending.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_bibi_li.mul: The boundary stone? My mother used to say grandfather Zhang borrowed ten taels from grandfather Li to buy a millstone. But who told my mother... hmm, Grandpa Xiang, when he was young and talkative.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_bibi_mei.mu: Zhang and Li? Oh my, oh my. My almanac says their signs match, but an almanac cannot beat two stubborn fathers. I won't have my name stained by a cancelled wedding.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_bibi_mei.sy: Proof, child. If you can prove the grudge is baseless, I will match them with the biggest feast of the year. Ask Grandpa Xiang under the pagoda tree. He was alive before that stone was planted.
Psst, come here a moment. You are a good sort, aren't you? My nephew Zhang Shan draws water every dawn just as the wine shop girl passes. Two buckets, one well, two hearts. And if their fathers find out, this well becomes a battlefield.
I will speak with the girl.

The well's boundary stone, they say. Grandfather Li moved it one step, or grandfather Zhang never paid a debt, depending on whom you ask. Forty years the two families have passed the same well without a greeting.
Li Ying is usually behind the wine shop, straining wine and singing. Don't say I sent you!
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_kakek_xiang: It fell into the well while they wrestled! In a tin box, if I remember. If the well was ever dredged, ask Auntie Wang. Her husband dredges wells, and she keeps every odd thing he finds.

That boundary stone? I remember the day. Grandfather Zhang paid the ten taels, in full, at the edge of the well. Grandfather Li wrote a receipt, then they drank too much and quarrelled over who could draw water faster.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_lari_zhang_: Li Ying is waiting at the gate with her bundle. We are ready. Please don't let bandits touch her.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_li_laoban.m: My daughter and that tofu boy? Hah! The Zhangs still owe my grandfather ten taels of silver. Pay that first, then we talk of sons-in-law!
Have you ever seen the IOU?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_li_laoban.s: The IOU? ...No. But my grandfather never lied. Well, except about the age of his wine.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_li_laoban_d: Call Auntie Mei. Call that stubborn tofu maker. I will open a twenty-year jar, and if he refuses to drink, I will cry first.
What receipt is that? ...This is my grandfather's hand. And his thumbprint. "Ten taels, paid in full." Forty years I hated a family that owed me nothing.
There is still time to mend it.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_li_ying.aya: My father hears only two things: the sound of a full jar and the word "Zhang", which he spits. I have tried.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_li_ying.mul: Auntie Zhang sent you, didn't she? Her face goes red whenever she keeps a secret. Yes... Zhang Shan and I. My father would smash every wine jar if he knew.
Why not tell your father yourself?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_li_ying.sur: Please give this to Zhang Shan. Don't read it! And... tell him I still keep his wooden bird.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_putusan.dam: Take it to Boss Li. If he still argues, show him his own grandfather's thumbprint!
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_putusan.lar: Elope? Like in Lao Shuo's tales! Oh, the road is full of bandits... do be careful!
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_putusan.mul: A tin box from the bottom of the well? Oh, I thought it was a ghost charm box! I kept it under my bed ten years, too scared to open it. There is an old paper inside with a thumbprint. What will you do with it?
(Reconcile) I will show this receipt to Boss Li.
(Elope) Better they simply leave for the Water City.
I need to think about it.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_tebus.mulai: Hic... you again. Come to mock me? She wears red silk now. Master Shen's silk.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_dua_zhang_laoto: A Li girl?! As long as I can grind soybeans, no Li sets foot in my yard. Their grandfather moved the well's boundary stone one step into our land!
Are you sure that is what happened?
My father said so! ...My father also spoke of a debt, ten taels, I am not sure who owed whom. Anyway the Lis are wrong.
A letter? From... from her? (He reads it three times, then tucks it inside his shirt.) She wants us to ask for a blessing. My father will throw the soy grinder at my head.
I will speak with both your fathers.
Thank you. If anyone can soften them, it is an outsider with no grudge. Auntie Mei matched half the West Residences, but she likes to be paid well.
Thank you. People say seventy-four years is age enough. No age is enough to lose an opponent. An opponent is rarer than a friend.
I want to ask something else.
Hm. You play the chariot like someone unafraid of losing. That is a good way. Xiang was like that, and lost more often than he admitted. Play again tomorrow, if you pass by.
I want to ask something else.
This board is too big now. For thirty years I moved my pieces while hearing Xiang grumble about his elephant. Today his elephant stays where it is, and I dare not touch it.
I am sorry for the loss of Grandfather Xiang.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_duka_kakek_xian: Thank you. People say seventy-seven years is age enough. No age is enough to lose an opponent. An opponent is rarer than a friend.
I want to ask something else.
Hm. You play the chariot like someone unafraid of losing. That is a good way. Che was like that, and lost more often than he admitted. Play again tomorrow, if you pass by.
I want to ask something else.
This board is too big now. For thirty years I moved my pieces while hearing Che grumble about his chariot. Today his chariot stays where it is, and I dare not touch it.
I am sorry for the loss of Grandfather Che.
The flower girl at the market corner? Ah, that is the temple gardener's granddaughter. Diligent, sweet, and she has refused three merchants' proposals. She says she will marry someone who can surprise her. Hm! An acrobat, you say?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_feihu_dengar.mu: My sister sent you, didn't she? I did not fall from carelessness! I fell because... because she laughed. The flower girl. Her laugh is like wind chimes. I do not even know her name.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_feihu_mulai.mul: My brother fell from the top of the pyramid yesterday. Not once in ten years! His eyes keep drifting to the flower stall at the corner of the market. If he stops focusing, he could break his neck. Please talk to him.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_feihu_putus.mul: She says she likes someone who can surprise her. I can somersault three times in the air! But the troupe leaves tomorrow, and my sister... my sister has no one but me.
(Stay) Your sister is strong. Follow your heart.
(Leave) The troupe is your family. Come back next spring.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_feihu_putus.per: ...You are right. But tomorrow I will throw a flower from the top of the pyramid. If she catches it, I will surely come back.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_feihu_putus.tin: I will tell my sister tonight. Then I will somersault in front of the flower stall, four times!
kultivator.cerita.kota42_geng_ajari.coba: In, in... out. Tok, tok... tok. Tok, tok... tok! I can do it! Don't tell Master I cried earlier.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_geng_ajari.mula: Tok, tok... tok! Wrong again! Master says the third watch is two quick, one slow, but my hands always follow my heart.
Follow your breath, not your heart. In, in, out.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_geng_pamit.mula: My hands will not keep still any more, and my eyes see two lanterns where there is one. It is time. Xiao Bang will lead the watch from next month.
You have guarded this city well, Grandpa.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_geng_pamit.teri: It was the city that kept me, child. Fifty years I was never alone on a dark street. When I go, strike this rattle once for me.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_geng_sapa.ikut: Bring a lantern. Do not talk while I call. And if you see fire, shout louder than me.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_geng_sapa.mulai: Hm? You walk like someone unafraid of the dark. Good. This city sleeps soundly because someone stays awake. Fifty years I have struck this rattle.
May I walk the watch with you?
What do the watch calls mean?
Who is the boy always behind you?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_geng_sapa.murid: Xiao Bang. Afraid of his own shadow, yet never absent. Courage is not the absence of fear, child. Courage is walking on while you shake.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_geng_sapa.serua: "Dry sky, beware of fire!" at the first watch. "Shut your doors, mind the thieves!" at the third. At the fifth we call "Dawn is coming, all is well". If one night I do not call, it means I have gone.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_geng_ziarah.mul: You came. Master asked that his rattle go to the one who walked with me when I still missed the beat. Tonight I walk the watch alone. Will you walk beside me, just once?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_hulu_sapa.beli: One pill for you! Swallow with warm tea, not wine, not on a moonless night, not while angry. If it fails, it must be one of those.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_hulu_sapa.bongk: No, no! Cabbages! Not cabbages! (He runs off hugging his gourd.)
kultivator.cerita.kota42_hulu_sapa.hadap: Shh! Not so loud! ...All right, all right. Half is flour. But the other half is my grandmother's recipe, and that truly works. I just never have enough herbs for all of it.
(Expose) Everyone at the market must know.
(Partner) Sell only the real ones. I pay for the herbs, we share the profit.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_hulu_sapa.manju: Half... ahem, fully effective! Look, I am healthy, aren't I? That is because I take them every day. Well, the green ones.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_hulu_sapa.mitra: Honest? Me? ...My grandmother will laugh in her grave. Very well. Partners.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_hulu_sapa.mulai: Step up, step up! Thousand-Virtue Pills! Headaches, heartaches, purse-aches: one pill, a thousand virtues! For you, a friend's price.
You do not have enough money.
You are a fraud, Hu Lu.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_hulu_tabib.mula: Three patients came to me this week, all of them took "Thousand-Virtue Pills" and all got worse. I cannot accuse without proof. Buy me one of those pills.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_hulu_uji.mulai: (He crushes the pill in a mortar, sniffs, tastes it with the tip of his tongue.) Rice flour, palm sugar and turmeric dye. Not a single herb. But... this one is different. (He holds up a second pill.) This one is real.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_bao.mulai: Shi Xiaoqian, the "Thousand-Finger Rat". Thirty pickpocket reports bearing his touch. The law punishes the hand that steals. But those children will not be punished for hunger. They will be taken to the temple.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_hu_lu.mula: The Ghost Market password? Shh! Cheap, cheap: two coins times your band, and I forget who asked.
You do not have enough money.
(Threaten) Or I tell everyone your pills are rice flour.
He is not afraid of you.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_hu_lu.sand: Tonight: "The moon has no shadow." The answer: "Because it is itself the sun's shadow." Don't get it wrong, Green Lantern does not like fools.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_lentera.ja: Rats always nest in the emptiest warehouse. The old salt store at the end of the Slums. And guest... the one you seek is not as wicked as you think. Only hungrier.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_lentera.mu: (A whisper from behind a paper mask.) The moon has no shadow...
Because it is itself the sun's shadow.
You do not know the password.
I am looking for Thousand Fingers.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_lentera.us: This market does not know those who do not know the night. Leave before my lantern goes out.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_modal.mula: Fifteen coins times your band for files, a small anvil and a month's rent. I will not run. I will not thank you too loudly either.
You do not have enough money.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_modal.teri: (He grips the purse for a long time.) ...The first shop in the Slums that sells nothing stolen. Imagine that.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_mulai.keja: Down fish alley! Every pickpocket in this city runs down fish alley, then vanishes like smoke. People say they work for one man. "Thousand Fingers", that is the name they whisper.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_mulai.mula: Thief! Thief! Oh, my purse! Five... no, ten children bumped me at once! A whole month's shopping money!
Calm down, Auntie. Which way did they run?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_sarang.inf: You are slier than you look. Very well. From today, your purse will never be lighter in this city.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_sarang.ins: A lock shop? (He laughs, then stops.) My father was a locksmith, before he died in debtors' prison. If you are serious... I need capital.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_sarang.mul: Bravo, bravo. Green Lantern sold me, eh? (A dozen children hide behind the salt sacks.) They eat twice a day because of me. What does this city give them? The whip.
(Hand over) The law is the law. You are coming to the Yamen.
(Informant) Work for me. Your pickpockets leave me alone, and you become my ears.
(Reform) Your hands are too valuable for picking pockets. Ever thought of opening a lock shop?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_sarang.ser: Hah. At least feed them before you go. That is all.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_jari_telusur.mu: Thousand Fingers? I heard it from the fishmonger, who heard it from the well-dredger, who... never mind. Anyway, all stolen goods are sold again at the Ghost Market. If you want more, ask Hu Lu the travelling physician. He is a regular there.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lagu_ah_qin.gur: Shi Banqiao. He played the erhu under bridges for forty years and never asked for money. He said a song that is paid for stops being a song. He died on a full-moon night, the bow still in his hand.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lagu_ah_qin.koi: Thank you. Do you hear? Even the strings are smiling.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lagu_ah_qin.mul: Your steps are new on this bridge. (Her fingers slide along the string, a long trembling note.) This song is not finished. My master died before teaching me its end. I play two-thirds of it every day, and every day I stop at the same place.
I will look for the rest of the song.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lagu_ah_qin.ter: Lao Shuo once sat beside my master. Start with him. And... thank you. It has been long since anyone asked.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lagu_lao_shuo.m: Shi Banqiao! Of course I remember. That song begins like water dripping from an oar: three notes falling, one rising note left hanging, like someone awaiting an answer. (He hums it softly.)
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lagu_main.main: (She listens with her head tilted, lips moving without sound. Then her bow touches the strings.) ...So this is how it ends. The moon does not set. The moon comes down to the river and stays there.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lagu_main.mulai: You are back. Your steps are heavier, as if you carry something. ...Did you find it?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.change: Once there were ten suns, and the earth burned until the rivers boiled. The archer Hou Yi shot down nine of them, and left one so the rice would still grow.
As a reward the Queen Mother of the West gave him one elixir of immortality, enough for a single person. Hou Yi put it away, for he did not want to live forever without his wife, Chang'e.

A greedy disciple broke into their house to seize the elixir. Chang'e swallowed it so it would not fall into his hands. Her body grew light and kept rising until she stopped on the moon, the closest place to her husband still in the sky.
Hou Yi set out cakes and fruit in the yard every full moon. That is why we eat mooncakes.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.delapa: Eight immortals came home from the Queen Mother of the West's banquet a little drunk, and reached the shore of the Eastern Sea. Lü Dongbin said: no clouds today, let each of us cross on our own treasure.
Iron-Crutch Li tossed his gourd, Zhongli his fan, and He Xiangu stood upon a lotus flower. Lan Caihe crossed on his clappers, and the Dragon King of the Eastern Sea coveted them.
The dragon prince snatched the clappers and dragged Lan Caihe to the bottom of the sea. The other seven raged; the sea was set ablaze, mountains were hurled and the dragon palace shook.
Ever since, people say: the eight immortals cross the sea, each showing their own power. Everyone has their own way.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.diri: Me? I am a man who has heard too much. I was once a palace scribe, then I learned the people's tales are more honest than the palace records. Since then I follow Madam Hong Ling wherever the cart wheels turn.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.diri.1: I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.hakim_: Judge Bao had a black face and a crescent moon on his brow. They say he judged men by day and ghosts by night. In his court stood three guillotines: the dragon head for nobles, the tiger head for officials, the dog head for commoners.
One day a village woman came carrying a child. Her husband, Chen Shimei, had passed the exam and married the emperor's daughter. To hide his past, Chen sent men to kill his own wife and child.

The princess and the empress dowager came to the court to beg for mercy. Judge Bao took off his official hat and laid it on the table. "If the law bows to the palace, this hat means nothing." Then he ordered the dragon-head blade unveiled.
That is why every Yamen hangs the board "A Clear Mirror Hung on High". A good judge cannot be bought.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.kera_s: On the peak of Flower Fruit Mountain lay a stone warmed by sun and moon for thousands of years. One morning it cracked, and out came a monkey whose eyes shot light all the way to heaven.

The monkey found a master and learned seventy-two transformations and a cloud somersault of a hundred and eight thousand li. The Heavenly Palace made him keeper of the horses. When he learned it was the lowest post of all, he rioted.
He stole the peaches of immortality, ate up Lao Jun's pills and beat a hundred thousand heavenly soldiers. Then the Buddha came with a wager: leap out of my palm, and heaven's throne is yours.

The monkey leapt to the end of the world and wrote his name on five pillars, which turned out to be the Buddha's fingers. Five hundred years he lay under a mountain. Remember that, young ones, whenever you feel stronger than heaven.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.kupu_k: Zhu Yingtai disguised herself as a young man so she could study at the Hangzhou academy. For three years she shared a room with Liang Shanbo, studying, arguing and laughing, and Liang never suspected.

At parting she gave a thousand hints: a pair of geese, a pair of fish. Innocent Liang understood none of them. When he finally understood and came to propose, Yingtai had already been promised to the wealthy Ma family's son.
Liang went home and died of a broken heart. On her wedding day, Yingtai's palanquin passed Liang's grave. A storm broke, the grave split open, and she leapt inside.
From the grave flew a pair of butterflies that never parted again. Do not match people by their purses, Auntie Mei.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.menu1: Choose. They are all true, and all a little lies.
The Stone Monkey Wrecks the Heavenly Palace
The White Snake of West Lake
The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl
Judge Bao and the Three Guillotines
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.menu2: These are tales I seldom tell. Listen well.
The Eight Immortals Cross the Sea
The Foolish Old Man Moves the Mountains
The Demon Prison Beneath the Mountain
The Sect That Came Down from the Clouds
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.mulai: Sit, sit! The tea is poured, the fan is open. Which tale will you hear tonight?
Do you know any secret places?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.mulan_: The loom fell silent, and Mulan sighed before the window. The conscription lists had come, twelve scrolls, and every scroll bore her old father's name.
She bought a horse in the east market, a saddle in the west, a bridle in the south and a whip in the north. Twelve years she fought on the frontier, and not one soul knew she was a woman.

The emperor offered her a minister's seat. She asked only for a swift camel to ride home. At home she put on her old clothes and combed her hair before the mirror. Her comrades stood gaping at the door.
The buck hare runs, the doe hare runs. When the two run side by side, who can tell them apart?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.pengge: The weaver of heaven, daughter of the Queen Mother of the West, wove the sunset clouds from threads of light. One day she came down to bathe in a river, and a poor cowherd hid her flying robe, as his ox had advised.

She could not go home, and then she fell in love. They married and had two children. The Queen Mother raged and dragged her daughter back. The cowherd chased her with the children in his carrying baskets.
The Queen drew her hairpin across the sky, and the uncrossable Silver River spread out. Only once a year, on the seventh night of the seventh month, magpies form a bridge so they can meet.
If it rains that night, they say it is their tears. So do not grumble when Qixi is wet.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.penjar: Before there were towns, the ancestor cultivators fought the demons for nine winters. They could not kill the demon king, so they buried him, heaped a mountain over him and wrote seals in the stone.

Each seal was kept by one family. Those families have long forgotten what they guard, but still burn incense every new moon. If you see ground that stays warm in the snow, or birds that will not land, do not dig.
My master said the seals crack every hundred years, and what comes out first is not the king but his children. The caves that newly appear on treasure hunters' maps... ah, perhaps it is only chance.
Sleep soundly. What guards a seal is not the stone, but the people who still remember why the stone is there.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.petunj: Secret places? Hmm. Listen to the tale of the Demon Prison closely, and mark which caves keep warm ground in the snow. Then ask the hunters in the teahouse, they know more than maps.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.sarjan: A young scholar saw a girl holding a sprig of plum blossom and laughing without end at the lantern festival. He fell ill with longing, then searched for her in a valley in the western hills, and found a house full of flowers.
The girl, Yingning, laughed whenever he spoke, and her very old grandmother only smiled. He brought her home and married her. Her laughter healed every quarrel in the household.

One day Yingning stopped laughing and confessed: her mother was a fox, and her grandmother the ghost who raised her. She asked her husband to move her grandmother's neglected grave beside the family tombs.
After that Yingning never laughed in front of others again, but she stayed kind. What is strange is not always wicked.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.sekte_: Above the clouds stand palaces that never touch the ground. Their disciples have never felt mud. One dry season, a sky sect saw the fields below cracking and children begging for water.

The elders said: mortal matters are not our matters. But the youngest disciple leapt down carrying a jar of spirit water. She poured the water into a dry well, and the well flowed again for three years without stopping.

Her sect cast her out for breaking the rules. She stayed in that village, teaching children to breathe properly. The village became a town, her pupils became a sect, and that sect never built a palace above the clouds.
If you see a sect gate whose doors are always open to townsfolk, perhaps it is hers.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.terima: Hoho, my tea is sweeter tonight. Come again tomorrow, the tales are not finished.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.ular_p: A white snake meditated a thousand years on Mount Emei until she could take a woman's shape. At West Lake, in a spring rain, she borrowed an umbrella from a young herbalist named Xu Xian.

They married and opened an apothecary, and the wife's remedies cured a plague no other healer could. But the monk Fahai saw scales beneath her skin and told Xu Xian to give her realgar wine on the Duanwu festival.
The wife turned into a snake before her husband's eyes, and Xu Xian died of fright. She flew to the mountain of the immortals, stole the herb of life and brought her husband back with bleeding hands.
Fahai imprisoned her under the Leifeng Pagoda. People say it would only fall when the lake ran dry. Who was crueller, the snake who loved or the man who feared? That you must answer yourselves.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_lao_shuo.yu_gon: Yu Gong was ninety years old, and his house was blocked by two mountains, Taihang and Wangwu. He gathered his family and said: let us level these mountains so the road south is open.
They carried earth and stone to the Bohai Sea. One round trip took a whole year. A clever man from the river bend laughed at him: you are old, you cannot even pull up a blade of mountain grass.

Yu Gong replied: when I die my son goes on; my son has grandsons, my grandsons have sons. The mountains grow no taller. The snake god who held the mountains heard him and took fright, and reported to the Emperor of Heaven.
The Emperor of Heaven was moved, and sent two giants to carry the mountains away. Perseverance moves heaven, not only mountains.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_pejabat_fang.mu: Proof? Here is my warehouse ledger. Three hundred sacks of rice went into Shen's storehouse at harvest, zero came out. And look at the stamp: "horse fodder grain". Whose horses eat three hundred sacks of rice?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_pejabat_qiu.car: Start as a scribe, rise to market overseer, then assistant judge. Every rank needs Good Name and realm. What is not written: every rank also offers envelopes. Refusing them is harder than rising a realm.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_pejabat_qiu.mul: Twenty years I have written taxes, and twenty years I have watched officials rise by envelopes and fall by envelopes. The Yamen needs someone who can judge a case without looking at the plaintiff's purse.
How does one join the Yamen?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_pejabat_qiu.ter: Decide three cases. Hear the witnesses, trace the evidence, and never open an envelope at the bench.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_pejabat_shen.mu: Ah, our honourable official. This famine is sad, so sad. I hear you are looking into my warehouse. Why trouble yourself? (A thick red envelope slides onto the table.) For your tea.
(Refuse) Keep your envelope. We meet at the Yamen.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_pejabat_shen.te: You are wise. Famine passes, and friends remain friends.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_pejabat_shen.to: (His smile freezes.) You will regret this. This city stands on my money.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_pelindung_he.ke: Our town is small, our tribute meagre. Great sects have fatter towns to guard. We are only a line in their ledger.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_pelindung_he.mu: Honoured cultivator... please. For three seasons I have written to our protector's mountain. No answer. Yesterday bandits took Eastern Village's whole corn harvest and two girls from the well road.
I will deal with those bandits.
Why does your protector sect not come?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_pelindung_he.te: Their camp is at the old post on the north road. May heaven protect you, since our sect does not.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_pelindung_panji: The whole town has gathered at the gate. The banner pole is painted red. Honoured one, this small town asks for your sect's protection. We are not rich, but we do not forget.
(The banner catches the wind and unfurls. Someone strikes a gong, then the whole town cheers.) From today we have a protector again.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_bibi_li.cu: Not suspicious. Careful. When everyone trusted that salt seller, I was the one who saw his scale tilt. Now he sells salt in prison.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_bibi_li.ka: I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_bibi_li.mu: You again. Three times past this well today. Here to draw water or to snoop?
Are you suspicious of everyone, Auntie?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_bibi_mei.j: Eight birth characters, the bride price, well gossip and a little incense. The rest is intuition. Two hundred couples, and only three divorced. Well, four, but the fourth was the almanac's fault.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_bibi_mei.k: I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_bibi_mei.m: Oh, a lucky face! Thick brows, long ears. Married yet? No? I have an almanac that can change that.
I am not looking for a match, Auntie.
Any news in the West Residences?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_bibi_mei.p: Everyone says that until they see the right person at the lantern festival. Come to the festival, wear something nice. Auntie is not pushing. Yet.
I want to ask something else.
I want to ask something else.
Careful on the road! Yesterday there was a wolf in fish alley! ...Well, a big dog. But very fierce!
Did you find your purse, Auntie?
Do you believe in ghosts, Auntie?
Believe? I have seen them! Every moonless night a green lantern floats at the end of the Slums. People call it a ghost market. I call it a market ghost. Different!
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_bibi_zhang: I want to ask something else.
Zhang Shan? A good boy, hardworking, too quiet. He carves wooden birds late into the night. For whom, I wonder? Auntie knows, but Auntie won't say.
I want to ask something else.
Come by, come by! The buns are still warm, take one. Don't tell Auntie Li, she will count how many I give away.
About Zhang Shan and the wine shop girl...
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_dalang_bao: A clear mirror hangs on high. What case brings you to the Yamen?
How are the small folk's cases judged?
The same as a noble's: witnesses, evidence, law. Assistant judges decide disputes over gardens and chickens. The heavy ones come to my bench. No case is too small for justice.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_fang_gudan: Name? Goods? Weight? Don't touch that sack, it is not weighed yet. If you want warehouse space, write here, legibly.
See the warehouse and trade contracts.
I dislike numbers that do not match. Shen's warehouse takes a hundred sacks and sends out ninety. Where do the ten go? Shen's rats must be very fat.
I want to ask something else.
Because the first weighing is for the merchant, the second for the truth. And the third, which I don't mention, for the rats.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_gao_senior: Jewels in the mud. Gifted children are born anywhere, even in the Slums. A pity if they rot into porters.
I want to ask something else.
You are in the way. ...Oh, a cultivator? Your realm is ordinary. My sect takes new disciples this season, but only pure roots.
What are you looking for in this city?
The strongest Righteous sect in this region. I need not say its name, you must have heard it. If not, that is your problem.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_gong_shu.b: Nails rust, pegs do not. A pegged house can sway in a quake and stand again. A nailed house breaks.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_gong_shu.k: Toward water and the trade roads. A city grows like a tree, toward light and water. My job is to see its branches do not choke the roads.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_gong_shu.m: Careful, that beam is not pegged yet. If you are passing, take the north side. If you want to help, take a hammer.
Craftsmen's children, merchants', officials'. On my benches they are all the same: hands that cannot yet write straight.
I want to ask something else.
I am no cultivator. But I have taught twenty years. A gifted child always asks "why" once more than the rest. And sometimes the leaves around them ask too.
I want to ask something else.
"Learning without thought is labour lost; thought without learning is perilous." Welcome. The children are reciting, don't disturb the back row, they are pretending to recite.
You seem to be thinking about something, Master.
Where do your pupils come from?
The lion drives off evil spirits that like hiding in corners still smelling of lime. And the neighbours learn someone new is rich enough to hire a lion.
I want to ask something else.
The Crescent Moon Troupe! Acrobats, lion dance, tales and songs! Here to watch or to book? Lion dance for a new house opening, this season's price is still friendly.
Were you really a rope dancer?
Why a lion dance for a new house?
Twenty people, three carts, one donkey more stubborn than Lao Shuo. We stay a week in every town, then move on. Our home is the road between two towns.
I want to ask something else.
A rope twenty paces long over the Qiantang river, no net. My knees creak like firewood now, so I moved to a more dangerous trade: leading twenty artists.
I want to ask something else.
Shh! Watch this move. Horse here, cannon there... CHECK! Hah! Xiang, you lose again!
Did you really beat a sect elder?
Will you play with me, Grandpa?
With you? Hmph. Come back after ten years of practice. Or tomorrow morning, if Xiang is late.
I want to ask something else.
Twelve moves! He came in a cloud robe and left with a red face. His name? Ah, I forget. But every move I remember! Horse, cannon, chariot...
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_kakek_xian: I win the first, he wins the second. Forty years like that. Don't tell him the second is my gift. Old men need a reason to get up in the morning.
I want to ask something else.
The west gate was still wood then, and this pagoda tree only waist-high. Your grandfather may have walked this road. A city changes its face, but the well stays where it is.
I want to ask something else.
Sit, young one. Don't talk while Che is thinking. He has been thinking since dawn.
Do you remember this city when you were young?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_lentera_hi: Three. Don't ask where goods come from. Don't say real names. And leave before the cock crows, because then this market never existed.
I want to ask something else.
(A whisper from behind the mask.) Tonight the market sells whatever the day has lost. Do you seek what was lost, or what never existed?
What are the rules of this market?
A face is merchandise. I sell mine every night and buy a new one every morning.
I want to ask something else.
My grandfather made the best wine in the capital and drank half of it himself. He was honest in everything, except the age of his wine and the number of cups he drank.
I want to ask something else.
The Li Family Wine Shop, standing since my grandfather's day! Sit, drink, and never mention the tofu maker across the street.
Like her mother. I will find her the best husband. One with a shop, with a name, one who is not... not from across the street.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_li_ying.ar: Young wine smells of morning, old wine of evening. Ten-year wine smells of memories. My father keeps one twenty-year jar, he says for my wedding.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_li_ying.mu: Peach-blossom wine, rice wine, plum wine. Want a sniff? This one is two years, that one five. I can tell their age with my eyes closed.
How do you tell a wine's age?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_li_ying.ny: Straining wine is slow and lonely. If I sing, time passes faster. And sometimes someone listens from behind the well fence.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_ma_fu.bega: Safe for those who pay guards. The southern bandits grow bolder since the protector sect there grew too lazy to come down.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_ma_fu.lang: This week: purple cloud tea from cliffs only monkeys can pick, and red salt crystals from a dead lake. The price? Depends how much you want it.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_ma_fu.mula: Merchant Ma Fu, caravans from seven towns! Silk, salt, spirit stones from closed mines. If my caravan does not have it, it has not been found yet.
What rare goods do you carry?
I hear you never forget a debt.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_ma_fu.utan: A debt is like a camel: unfed, it still lives and still asks for water. I only remind the camels.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_nenek_tang: Xiaomi, my granddaughter. Quick hands, a good heart, but not yet patient. Hurried soup tastes like tears.
I want to ask something else.
Cold, isn't it? Sit by the pot. Granny does not ask if you have money, Granny asks if you have eaten.
Do you need soup ingredients, Granny?
What is the secret of your soup, Granny?
Who is the girl helping you?
A secret? Bones simmered since dawn, old ginger, and patience. And one more thing, but if Granny tells, it is no longer a secret.
I want to ask something else.
Every funeral is someone's last story. I only make sure it is told well. The hard part is not the dead, but those left behind.
I want to ask something else.
Walk softly here, child. Spirits like quiet.
How do you bear this work, Uncle?
Why must the names of the dead be spoken?
As long as their name is spoken, they still have a home in this world. That is why we burn paper money and say names on Qingming. Not only for them. For us too.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_qiu.mulai: Has this month's stall tax been paid? If not, queue over there. If so, keep the receipt safe.
Open the book of offices and cases.
What is the tax used for?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_qiu.pajak: Walls, roads, the granary, the guards' pay, and the lanterns on night streets. If you want the exact figures, the ledger is open here. I write it to be read, not hidden.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_shen_wan.d: A hundred lanterns every festival! The gods must know who pays for their light. And the monks too, since their temple roof is still in pawn to me.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_shen_wan.m: Welcome to the Counting House! Saving, borrowing, investing: Shen Wan serves with a smile. Even the interest smiles.
I hear you donate lanterns to the temple.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_shen_wan.p: Easy! Thumbprint here, here and here. Five per hundred every seven days, due in seven days. If you are late... well, the Yamen has its own opinion.
I want to ask something else.
With a girl from a family with a shop, so that I "learn trade". Poor girl. I cannot even haggle over a fan.
I want to ask something else.
You like my fan? Water City silk, cranes painted by a court artist. Thirty taels. My uncle says it is a waste.
Is your uncle a hard man?
I hear you are to be matched.
He counts the grains in my rice bowl. He says if I can count rice, I can count silver. I prefer counting stars.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_shi_xiaoqi: They eat because of me. If this city gave them rice, they would not need fingers this quick.
I want to ask something else.
Ten years of hunger teach fingers faster than any master. Want to know where the coin is? Check your pocket.
I want to ask something else.
My, your purse is fat. Don't worry, I am on holiday. (He rolls a coin across his knuckles, and it vanishes.)
Do those children work for you?
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_tang_xiaom: To make the same soup as Granny's. That is all. Sounds small, doesn't it? But that soup brings people back to life.
I want to ask something else.
One bowl or two? Fresh broth, radish sliced by me. Granny says my slices are too thin, but customers like them.
She coughs more this season, but refuses to stop cooking. She says if she stops, she will stop everything.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_tetua_he.k: Three hundred years. Our ancestors were flood refugees who found high ground here. We were never rich, but never gave up either.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_tetua_he.m: Welcome to our small town. The north road is unsafe, take the river road.
The dough rests overnight, then is slammed, pulled, folded. Thirteen folds, eight thousand strands. My grandfather could do fourteen. I cannot yet.
I want to ask something else.
Hand-pulled noodles! One strand from rim to rim. Long life for whoever eats it, aching arms for whoever makes it.
How do you pull noodles that long?
Busy, but the money does not stay long. Every month someone comes to fetch it. Never mind, spicy or not?
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_wu_niangzi: Receipts. Every coin of interest we have paid the Shen family since my husband was a boy. The tin has filled up twice.
I want to ask something else.
Please sit, sir. Tea is free, noodles are not. Sorry, the tea is not very good either.
What tea tin are you holding?
I stole a bun from a cart when I was seven. Master caught me, bought two more buns, and told me to hold his lantern until morning. I never went back to the Slums.
I want to ask something else.
Eh! You startled me! Sorry, I thought your shadow was a black dog. Good... good afternoon? I just woke up. Night watchmen sleep by day.
A night watchman afraid of the dark?
How did Lao Geng take you in?
Master says that is the point. Someone unafraid of the dark never notices what hides in it.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_xiao_yu.gu: Mother makes them, I blow the wings! Want one? It tastes like the evening sun.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_xiao_yu.mu: Big sister! Big brother! Can you fly? Just once, show me your sword! I promise I won't tell Mother!
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_xiao_yu.se: I peek into Master Zhou's class through the window! I already know a hundred characters. My favourite is "fly".
I want to ask something else.
Settle? That is for old people and trees. ...Why do you ask? Did someone say something about the flower stall?
I want to ask something else.
Watch this! (He flips twice and lands on one hand.) Hah! My sister took twice as long to learn that.
What is it like at the top of the pyramid?
Ever want to settle in one town?
Like being a king. Everyone looks up, and nobody knows the legs beneath me are shaking. My sister's legs, I mean.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_yan_feiyan: Ten thousand falls. On the ten thousand and first, you stand. That is all. My brother needed five thousand, and he never stops bragging about it.
I want to ask something else.
Careful, the plates are still spinning! ...There. Welcome. The next show is after the evening bell.
You look worried. About your brother?
How can you stand on plates?
An acrobat school for flood orphans, like we once were. I have saved eighty coins. I need a thousand.
I want to ask something else.
Clever. Too clever for a porter's child. Sometimes I fear her, sometimes I fear for her.
I want to ask something else.
Because I would say tomorrow I am sure to win. And you would know I am lying. And so would I.
I want to ask something else.
Need a porter? A hundred jin, two coins. More than that, one more. Don't ask about the dice table.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_yu_xiunian: Palm sugar heated to the colour of old honey, then poured while breathing slowly. If your hand hesitates, the dragon becomes a worm. If your heart hesitates, the sugar cracks.
I want to ask something else.
Dragon or crane? One coin. For children, half. For those who look sad, free.
How do you paint with sugar?
Your daughter is special, isn't she?
Every mother says so. But not every mother sees petals turn toward her child's laughter.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_zhang_laot: Don't say that name in front of my tofu. It might sour.
I want to ask something else.
Tofu! Soft tofu, dried tofu, stinky tofu! The stinky one is the best, don't listen to your nose.
What is the secret of your tofu?
What about your neighbours, the Lis?
Well Street's well water. The sweetest water in the West Residences. That is why that well is worth fighting over.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sapa_zhang_shan: He is kind, but his tongue is sharp. And he never forgets anything from forty years ago. Yesterday he forgets.
I want to ask something else.
(He stops carving and hides something behind his back.) Oh! Want tofu? Fresh tofu, ten trays a day, my father makes it. I do the grinding.
A bird. A wooden bird. For... for the neighbour's little sister. Which neighbour? Ahem. How many trays of tofu?
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sup_bagi.mulai: Granny Tang sent a pot this big? A hundred people are queueing at the temple. Take that big ladle, we share it out together. One bowl, one smile.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sup_bagi.selesa: Look at those faces. Laba porridge is not about a full belly, child. It is about remembering someone cares.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sup_cucu.garam: I tried. And ginger, and scallion, and... it is not that.
Granny always served the coldest person first.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sup_cucu.ingat: (She looks at the queue, then ladles the first bowl for the old beggar at the end of the line.) ...Yes. That is it. It tastes the same.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sup_cucu.mulai: I use all Granny's ingredients, but the soup is not the same. The regulars say it is good, but they lie so I won't cry. You cooked with Granny once. What did I forget?
Granny always served the coldest person first.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sup_mulai.butuh: Beetroot and carrots from the fields, two mushrooms from the woods, dried kelp from the fish seller, and a bowl of ginseng soup from the eating house for the stock. Granny is too old to walk that far.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sup_mulai.mangk: All gone, child, all gone. Granny will cook again tomorrow, if there are ingredients.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_sup_mulai.mulai: Oh dear, oh dear. The pot is empty, and the queue still reaches the gate. This winter is so fierce. If nobody helps, the Slum children will sleep with cold bellies.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_tumbuh_kayu.mul: The bandits fled? Splendid! The timber wagons leave now. This receipt is for Gong Shu. Half price, as promised.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_tumbuh_ma_fu.ka: Good! And just in time: see the masked men behind those sacks? They have followed my wagons since the bamboo grove. Drive them off, and I send the timber to the foreman.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_tumbuh_ma_fu.mu: Teak for Gong Shu? Yes, yes. Three wagons in the south warehouse. But the road is full of bandits, and bandits do not pay for timber. If you clear the road, my price for a friend drops by half.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_tumbuh_mulai.ba: Ma Fu has teak, but he won't send it without guards. Talk to him, he is usually at the caravan warehouse.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_tumbuh_mulai.ki: "Building Standards", written by Li Jie for the Song court. Beam sizes, roof pitch, all counted in cai units. A house built by this book does not fall in a small quake. I read it the way others read poetry.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_tumbuh_mulai.mu: See those stakes? A house will stand there, then a street, then a whole quarter. A city that stops growing starts dying, my great-grandfather said. The trouble is, this city grows faster than its timber.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_tumbuh_resmi.mu: The roof is up, the walls are limewashed. Madam Hong Ling's lion dance waits at the end of the street. Will you cut the ribbon? You deserve it most.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_tumbuh_resmi.po: Congratulations! The first house on the new street. From today this street has a name, and that name is yours.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_utang_minta.awa: My husband's grandfather borrowed five taels to open this stall. Five taels! Now Master Shen says two hundred. Ask my husband, he keeps the IOU under the wok board.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_utang_minta.mul: Excuse me... sorry to bother you. Every month Master Shen's men come to collect interest, and every month our debt grows. My husband is too ashamed to speak. I am not.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_utang_modal.mul: Capital? With twelve coins times your band we could buy a new iron wok and a signboard. New wok, faster broth, no waiting customers.
You do not have enough money.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_utang_modal.ter: Tomorrow the sign will be up. Just wait a week, you will see the queue!
kultivator.cerita.kota42_utang_qiu.mulai: (He reads, dips his brush, works the abacus.) Interest on interest, three in ten a year. City law caps interest at thirty-six per hundred and forbids adding it to the principal. The Wu family has already paid four times the original loan.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_utang_qiu.pilih: Three roads. Pay the rest so it ends without fuss. Take it to Judge Bao, and Master Shen loses face and money. Or make the stall profitable enough to pay for itself, if you have capital and patience.
(Invest) I will invest in the Wu stall.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_utang_shen.luna: A pleasure doing business. You may burn the IOU. Remember, the Counting House is always open to you.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_utang_shen.mula: The Wu family's debt? One hundred eighty-six taels, four qian. But for an honoured guest like you, twenty times your band will do. I am a generous man, am I not?
You do not have enough money.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_utang_wu_dalang: My wife told you? (He sighs and wipes his floury hands.) Here is the paper. Grandfather wrote it before I was born: "interest three in ten each year, added to the principal". My father paid, I pay, and my son will pay too.
Let the Yamen clerk recalculate it.
Clerk Qiu? They say he is the only official who cannot be bought. I hope that is true.
Donkey hide, a hundred days... fine goods. Six coins times your band, and this puppet goes home to its master. Or would you rather try taking it? My children love to play.
You do not have enough money.
(Seize) Hand it over, or your lantern goes out.
Heh heh. Children, our guest wants to play.
This market always keeps its word. That is why it still exists.
The audience is seated, the lamp is lit. You strike the gong tonight. Watch the shadows of sword and staff. When they meet, strike!
GONG! Perfect! Hear that cheer? My master must be smiling up there.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_wayang_rebut.mu: Enough, enough! My children have played their fill. Take your puppet. But remember, the Ghost Market has a long memory.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_wayang_su.cara: An oil lamp behind, the cloth in front, the puppets between. The audience sees shadows, I see puppets. The hard part is not the hands but the voice: six voices, one throat, and the gong must fall just as swords meet.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_wayang_su.cari: That night Auntie Wang said she saw a shadow leap from the theatre roof. Auntie Wang always sees shadows, but this time she may be right.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_wayang_su.mulai: Six puppets, six lives. Now only five. The Monkey King my master made, donkey hide tanned a hundred days, vanished from its box. Without him, the Journey to the West cannot be played.
How is a shadow play performed?
That shadow! Yes! Small, quick, like a real monkey! Then next morning the fishmonger's boy said a puppet was for sale at the Ghost Market. Oh, what if the puppet came alive and ran off by itself!
kultivator.cerita.kota42_zhuazhou_li_lao: My daughter gave birth? Without me there? ...Fetch my finest jar. I will not let that tofu maker give a bigger gift than mine.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_zhuazhou_zhang_: A grandchild? In the Water City? ...The boy was a fool to run off. But a grandchild is a grandchild. Fine, I will come, as long as the wine seller doesn't sit next to me.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_zuixian_giok.mu: The seventh night, and you are still awake! "The wine is gone, the moon still full; the friend departs, the verse remains." ...That is the seventh verse. Now hold out your hand.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_zuixian_sapa.be: Stop? If I stop drinking, I must stop writing. If I stop writing, I must become an official. Which is worse for this city?
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_zuixian_sapa.gi: Hah! True. Seven nights, seven cups, seven verses. If you are still awake at the seventh verse, the jade is yours. Bring your own wine, I am a poet, not a merchant.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_zuixian_sapa.mi: "The moon in the cup, the cup in the hand, the hand in the moon..." Hic. Good, good! You are still awake. Come again tomorrow night!
kultivator.cerita.kota42_zuixian_sapa.mu: Ah, a new face! Sit, sit. I am writing a verse about the moon falling into a cup, but the cup keeps emptying before the verse is done. Do you know why? Because I drink it!
I hear you keep a technique jade.
(Drink together: a cup of peach-blossom wine)
Bring peach-blossom wine, and come at night.
kultivator.cerita.kota42_zuixian_sapa.uj: Three times! The first time I wrote that the examiner was dumber than his ox. The second, that the ox was offended. The third... I do not remember, I was drunk. But my verses are still sung at every lantern festival.
I want to ask something else.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_akar_lang: There are three ways to hold off Gao's offer: pay the father's gambling debt, win over the mother, or beat Gao in a friendly bout.
Master Zhou spoke of floating leaves. Find Xiao Yu in the Slums.
Xiao Yu follows Senior Brother Gao.
Xiao Yu went up to the Righteous sect's mountain. One day, at the Grand Tournament, a girl in white with leaves circling her will say your name before drawing her sword.
Xiao Yu tied her bundle with her mother's red ribbon. In your sect's hall the courtyard leaves whirl whenever she laughs, and the other disciples have started laughing too.
Xiao Yu stays in Master Zhou's class. She now uses the leaves floating around her to tell medicinal herbs apart; one day she will be the city's most beloved physician.
Xiao Yu's mother wants to tell you about her daughter's zhuazhou day. Listen to her, then decide the child's future with her family.
A little girl from the Slums makes leaves float when she laughs. A sect recruiter has already made her father an offer.
Beat Senior Brother Gao in a friendly bout (it stops when one side is down to a tenth).
Senior Brother Gao has offered money to Xiao Yu's father. Speak with Yu Laosan and with Gao himself.
Xiao Yu stays in the city.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_banjir_mu: Sand alone is not enough, the bank needs retaining posts. Bring thirty-two logs.
The water rose to the embankment's waist and stopped. At dawn the lower quarter's people brought buns to your watch post, and Foreman Gong Shu only said, "A good peg never shows off."
The water peaks at night. Join the night watch and keep an eye on the embankment through the dark.
The embankment held. Report to Foreman Gong Shu.
An emergency embankment needs sandbags. Bring sixty-four blocks of sand to Foreman Gong Shu.
The mountain snow is melting and the river is rising. Foreman Gong Shu needs an emergency embankment before water reaches the lower quarter.
Families by the river refuse to leave. Help two residents settle their affairs so they can evacuate.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_catatan_k: And the town's future is out in the alleys with the children. Ask which games are the fashion in the lanes.
Clerk Qiu reads your notes twice, strikes out one overly flowery adjective and stamps the page. "Honest writing. You are fit to be an Honorary Scribe."
Bring your notes to Clerk Qiu.
Clerk Qiu is compiling the town's new record book and needs someone who will walk, ask and write honestly.
The town's history lives in its elders' heads. Hear an elderly resident and note what they remember.
A record starts with its people. Talk with five residents, anyone, and note how they fare.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_dua_kelua: Bring the receipt from the bottom of the well to Boss Li.
Ten days passed. Li Ying was promised to Master Shen's nephew, and Zhang Shan started drinking.
Auntie Zhang whispers of secret meetings at the well at dawn. Find Li Ying, the wine shop's daughter.
The couple live happily in the Water City. The two fathers on Well Street do not speak to each other, yet both quietly ask about a grandchild not yet born.
The wedding of Well Street's two families was celebrated for three days and nights. Their first child will one day bear an honorary name after yours.
You missed the feast, but a piece of wedding cake was set aside for you.
Zhang Shan stopped drinking and is back grinding soybeans before dawn. He no longer draws water when Li Ying passes, but he smiles again.
The couple begs for a blessing. Speak with Old Zhang, Boss Li and Auntie Mei the matchmaker.
Escort Zhang Shan and Li Ying to the Water City. Bandits like to waylay eloping couples on the road.
They reached the Water City and married under a lantern-lit bridge.
The families are reconciled. Attend the wedding of Zhang Shan and Li Ying.
The wedding took place without you, but both families are still grateful.
You know the truth: the old debt was paid, and the receipt fell to the bottom of the well. Choose the way: reconcile the families, help the lovers elope to the Water City, or leave it be.
The tofu maker's son and the wine seller's daughter love each other, but their families have feuded since their grandfathers fought over the well's boundary stone.
Li Ying entrusted you with a letter. Deliver it to Zhang Shan without his father seeing.
Zhang Shan spends his nights at the tavern. Perhaps a cup of heart-calming tea and a friend can pull him back.
Nobody is sure how the feud began. Trace the gossip about the well's boundary stone back to its source, and ask the oldest man in the West Residences.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_hati_feih: Auntie Mei knows every girl in this city. Ask her about the flower girl.
Feihu climbed to the top of the pyramid once more at the farewell show and threw a flower into the crowd. The girl caught it. The troupe promised to return next spring.
Feihu sold his acrobat shoes and opened a stall next to the flower stall. He still somersaults every morning, just to make one girl laugh. Feiyan cried at the gate, then smiled.
The Top of the Pyramid Falls in Love
The troupe leaves tomorrow. Help Feihu choose: stay in the city for love, or leave with his sister.
Yan Feihu, the youngest acrobat of the Crescent Moon Troupe, has fallen for a flower girl and wants to leave the troupe.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_kota_tumb: The timber has arrived. Gather sixty-four roof tiles (clay bricks) for the roof.
Madam Hong Ling brought a lion dance, Foreman Gong Shu cut the red ribbon, and at the end of the new street now hangs a signboard with your name.
Ma Fu's timber caravan is stalked by bandits. Beat the bandits on the road, then escort his wagon to the city.
The bandits have fled. Report to Ma Fu so his timber wagons can set off.
The foundation is staked, but there is no timber. Ask Merchant Ma Fu, his caravan brings teak from the south.
The builders work day and night. Wait until the plot stands, then attend its opening.
Foreman Gong Shu wants to raise the first new plot at the capital's edge, but timber and tiles do not arrive by themselves.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_lagu_jemb: An opera lover in another town is said to hum that song. Find them.
Lao Shuo once heard Shi Banqiao play. Ask him for the first phrase.
The last phrase is remembered only by an erhu player in the Water City, where Shi Banqiao was born.

Under the stone bridge, Ah Qin played her master's song from beginning to end for the first time. Traders stopped haggling, children stopped running, and for a moment the whole market listened to the moon.
Bring all three phrases to Ah Qin.
Ah Qin seeks the tune of her late master's last song, "Moon Under the Bridge", across three towns.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_lentera_l: Xiao Bang still misses the beat at the third watch. Teach him the five-beat pattern.
Xiao Bang's voice cracked at the first watch and was steady by the fifth. Lao Geng's old rattle now hangs at your belt, and whenever it sounds, night watchmen everywhere turn their heads.
Lao Geng died in his sleep, his rattle beside him. Attend his funeral.
Lao Geng has decided to retire. Meet him at the gate watch post.
Tonight Xiao Bang walks the watch alone with his master's gong. Walk with him on his first round.
The capital's oldest night watchman wants to pass his rattle to his timid apprentice before his lantern goes out.
Walk the night watch with Lao Geng for three nights, from the first watch to the fifth.
You missed the funeral. Xiao Bang waits for you at his master's grave.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_malam_way: Hear Puppeteer Su about the missing puppet.
The Monkey King leapt across the screen, your gong rang just as sword met staff, and the audience rose cheering. From tonight you never need to pay for a shadow-theatre ticket again.
Return the puppet to Puppeteer Su.
The Night of the Shadow Play
Premiere night! Puppeteer Su asks you to strike the gong to the show's rhythm.
Puppeteer Su's oldest Monkey King puppet was stolen three days before the premiere.
The puppet is for sale at the Ghost Market. Ransom it or seize it from Green Lantern's hands.
Trace the gossip about the stolen puppet. Who saw it first?
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_pejabat_j: The great case at the Yamen: seize Master Shen's hoard for the city granary, or accept his envelope.

Three hundred sacks of rice left Master Shen's warehouse for the city granary. Prices fell within a week, and Clerk Qiu wrote your name on the list for Magistrate with the same brush he has used for twenty years.
The envelope was thick and smelled of sandalwood. Food prices stayed high all season, and Clerk Qiu no longer meets your eyes. Auditors from the capital have begun opening old ledgers.
Famine! Food prices rise by half again. Madam Fang suspects Master Shen of hoarding rice. Gather proof.
Clerk Qiu is looking for someone willing to rise without envelopes. Then famine comes, and Master Shen hoards rice.
As a city official, decide three court cases fairly.
The hoard is seized for the granary.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_pelindung: Your sect's banner flies over the gate. Children dare to play until dusk, and Elder He burns incense for your ancestors though he does not know who they are.
Clear out the nearest bandit camp.
The people wait at the gate. Raise your sect's banner.
A town's protector sect has not come for three seasons, and bandits have begun to rule its roads.
Beasts besiege the town. Defend it in its first raid under your protection.
An envoy of the old sect comes to challenge you for "stealing" their town. Beat him in a bout.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_restu_aya: The father wants to know what kind of person would take his child away. Prove yourself useful: finish one resident's request.
Visit the child's family. Hear the father's objections to the end without interrupting.
Bring a small gift to his house. A cake, a pouch of tea, anything, as long as it is from the heart.
The father lets out a long sigh. "I do not like you, but I trust your hands. Take her. And tell her to come home at New Year."
Speak with the father once more. Perhaps his heart has softened.
A father refuses to let his gifted child go to a sect because he wants the child to carry on the family trade. His blessing must be earned by deeds, not coin.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_seribu_ja: This city's pickpockets no longer touch your pockets, and every dusk a child slips you a scrap of paper: where the Ghost Market opens that night.
The "Thousand Fingers" lock shop opened at the edge of the Slums. Hands that once opened other people's purses now open padlocks whose keys are lost, and the children behind him learn to file iron.
Shi Xiaoqian was flogged and sent to the salt mines. His children were taken to the temple, and one of them, whose fingers make coins float, turned up at the Recruitment Office.
Shi Xiaoqian is now your eyes and ears.
Fund Shi Xiaoqian to open a locksmith's shop.
Auntie Wang's purse was picked at the market. Catch a pickpocket.
The Ghost Market and the Thousand Fingers
The Slum pickpockets work for one man. The trail leads to the Ghost Market and Mister Green Lantern.
Every trail ends at the Ghost Market. Find tonight's password, then meet Mister Green Lantern when the market opens.
Green Lantern pointed to an old warehouse in the Slums. Confront Shi Xiaoqian, the Thousand-Finger Rat.
Hand Shi Xiaoqian over to Judge Bao.
The pickpocket mentioned "Thousand Fingers". Trace the gossip about him to its source.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_sup_hanga: The soup is boiling. Share out the porridge at the temple with Uncle Bai.
Gather eight soup ingredients for Granny Tang: two beetroots, two carrots, a brown mushroom, a red mushroom, dried kelp, and a bowl of spirit ginseng soup from the eating house.
Tang Xiaomi carries on her grandmother's stall, but the soup does not taste the same. Perhaps you remember something she forgot.
Granny Tang's secret ingredient was not an ingredient: she always served the coldest person first. The stall still opens every winter, and the first bowl always goes to whoever is shivering.
Granny Tang is very old. Come and visit her next winter.
On Laba day, Granny Tang's soup pot ran dry before half the queue was served.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kota42_tabib_kel: Buy one "Thousand-Virtue Pill" from Hu Lu.
The pill is rice flour. Confront Hu Lu: expose him before the market, or make him an honest partner.
The market drove Hu Lu out with rotten cabbages. The Crescent Moon Troupe still takes him to the next town, but his gourd now holds only pills that work, at three times the price.
Hu Lu tipped his rice flour into the river and sells the genuine half at an honest price. A fifth of his profit now reaches your purse, and strangely he looks happier.
The town physician suspects half of travelling physician Hu Lu's pills are nothing but coloured rice flour.
Take the pill to the town physician to be examined.
